definitions.explanation: The essential points or basic framework of a plan, argument, or document, stripped of detail. Common in formal and written contexts such as proposals and reports.

examples.japanese: ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{骨子|こっし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}する→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧。
examples.english: to explain the outline of the plan

examples.japanese: ⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{骨子|こっし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦まとまった→まとまる：01642_matomaru⟧。
examples.english: The main points of the bill have been put together.

examples.japanese: ⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{骨子|こっし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一枚|いちまい}→一枚：08889_ichimai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まとめて→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}した→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧。
examples.english: I summarized the gist of the report on a single page and submitted it.

notes:
A formal word, literally 'bones', used for the essential framework or main points of something. Frequent in news and business writing about plans, bills, and proposals.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{骨子|こっし}: the outline of a plan
- {骨子|こっし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめる→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧: to put together the main points
- {骨子|こっし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧: to lay out the framework

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{要点|ようてん}→要点：01668_youten⟧: key points — the important items, less about overall structure
- ⟦{大筋|おおすじ}→大筋：07287_oosuji⟧: general outline; broad gist — the rough flow rather than the skeleton
